plan.algorithm: Behavior cloning of analytic face/distance actions
plan.data_note: Archived heuristic action labels projected onto configuration inputs; no velocity/countdown inputs. No archived return targets used.
plan.selection: Lowest held-out demonstration imitation loss, evaluated every 20 epochs
plan.critic: Not pretrained; PPO initializes a fresh critic for the current objective
plan.deployment: Neural actor only: no analytic action, correction, or fallback
